mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals increased consumer demand and earnings momentum, which raises S&P 500 forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when PAYEMS 3-month change exceeds 150k.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Houston housing price index exceeding 5% indicates weakening housing demand, which reduces household wealth and consumer spending, lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST 2-month change falls below -5.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the industrial production index below 0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower corporate earnings, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO 3-month change is below 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS 3-month average exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures per capita exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, lowering S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 3-month change is below -2.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and input costs, reducing profit margins and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE 3-month change is below -0.4.
